about: A heater shield: a flat-topped, pointed board strapped on the forearm by two straps (enarmes), with a rim. Today's shield in the fight.

lead.source: D463 and holding.md: the off hand, the right on a left-handed body, turned and never scaled by -1

grip_type.source: D562: strapped, no finger layer; the fist holds the clips' Strap_Grip in the hand strap and the board rides the forearm (terra_walker::strap, D504)

slots.name: board
slots.joins: its frame's origin is the hand strap's grip (the strapped mount's origin, D546); its rim is a full point

slots.name: enarmes
slots.joins: two leather straps on its back along +Y: the hand strap at the origin and the arm strap at the board's arm_strap point, up the forearm's line

slots.name: rim
slots.joins: its seat (a full point) on the board's rim point; a heater's rim fits only boards of its outline

grip.how: the board's origin, the hand strap where the fist closes (heater_shield.json's grip): the strapped look's origin, +Y up the forearm toward the arm strap, front -Z

second.how: held on one arm; the arm strap is on the grip's own line, not a second hand's

edge.how: its face for a block and a bash: the board's rim point (its outline and centre) carried through

held.how: the board low at the left hip, face out, in the guard, and further out in the strafes (Low_Guard and Low_Strafe's targets, art/animation/shield_targets.json); the arm solved to put the strapped board there

used.how: in sword.shielded: the block (Clear_Block, a parry at its start); a bash is off-heavy in holding.md, not built

open.why: the shield bash and shield.alone (holding.md) have no clips

carried.how: on the forearm at the left side, the upper arm out, in the round shield's carry pose (upright), 10 cm clear of the body at worst (a jump's start; it went 5-15 cm in with the walker's arm); a strapped look is not tipped (attachment.md Carried)

stowed.how: on the back, first, a bow or polearm beside it

open.why: the turn and offset on the socket are not set (attachment.md Stowed's next step)

blocking.how: the board raised before the chest (Raised_Block's target, captured with this shield), the arm solved to it

animation.how: sword.shielded's shield moves and guards (assets/data/moves/sword.shielded.ron); shield.alone none yet

open.why: shield.alone (bash, block, fists; holding.md) has no clips

length_m.source: assets/data/items.ron hold.length; the look's bounds measured 0.762 by 0.619

head_mass_kg.source: the board, items.ron's mass less the straps and rim (about 0.2 kg, recalled)

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's I = m (b^2 + L^2/12) on the numbers above

open.why: a hand strap has no diameter the fingers close on (D562 lays none strapped); its width comes with the enarmes' numbers

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's tempo clamp 0.85 to 1.15 for its block and bash: I_ref/1.15^2 to I_ref/0.85^2

head_mass_kg.source: the inertia band at the reference's length and balance (the whole 2.65 to 4.84 kg), less the straps and rim's 0.2 kg

balance_m.source: the inertia band at the reference's mass and length, solved for the balance

envelope.state: computed from items.ron's stand-in; the targets were captured with this shield, so the reference holds in them
